title: Users & roles
subtitle: Who can sign in to this organisation, what they may do, and which branches they see.

fields.allBranchesHint: Turn off to limit access to selected branches.
fields.allBranchesScoped: Your own access is limited to some branches: you can only give access to those branches.
fields.branchesRequired: Select at least one branch or grant all branches
fields.linkEmployeeHint: Lets the user see their own attendance and request corrections.

members.emptyHint: Invite colleagues to give them access.
members.ownerHint: Only owners can change the owner role; the last active owner cannot be demoted.
members.ownerSelfHint: As an owner you can link your login to your employee record; your role, branches and status can only be changed by another owner.
members.statusHint: Suspending revokes the user's sessions immediately.
members.suspendHint: The user loses access immediately and their sessions are revoked. Their history stays. You can reactivate them later.

invite.title: Invite member
invite.hint: The invitation is bound to this email and expires in 7 days.
invite.createdHint: An invitation e-mail is on its way to {{email}}. You can also share the link below — it is shown only once.
invite.createdExisting: {{email}} already has an account — a pending membership was created. The invitation is e-mailed to them; you can also share the link below.
invite.tokenOnce: Copy it now — the token is never shown again. Expires {{expires}}.

invitations.hint: Pending invitations. Revoking also removes the pending membership.
invitations.emptyHint: Invited users appear here until they accept.

roles.hint: System roles are fixed. Create custom roles to grant an exact permission set.
roles.createHint: Pick a name and the permissions this role grants.
roles.deleteHint: Roles assigned to members or pending invitations cannot be deleted.
roles.grantHint: You can only grant permissions you hold yourself. Locked permissions are outside your own role.
roles.notHeld: You do not hold this permission

resend.title: Resend the invitation to {{email}}?
resend.hint: The current link stops working at once. A new invitation, valid for 7 days, is e-mailed to the same address with the same role and branches.
resend.done: A new invitation was e-mailed to {{email}}

delivery.title: E-mail to {{email}}
delivery.notConfigured: E-mail sending is not configured on the server — share the link instead.
delivery.requeued: The invitation e-mail to {{email}} was queued again
delivery.stale: The e-mail service has not picked this e-mail up yet — the link above works meanwhile.

access.title: FlowZa Time access
access.hint: The employee's own login to FlowZa Time (portal and app).
access.inviteHint: An invitation valid for 7 days is e-mailed to the address you choose. The role defaults to Employee and the scope to the employee's branch.

address.pick: Choose the address yourself: the address fields can be edited by people who cannot grant logins.
address.recent: Changed in the last 7 days by someone else — confirm it with the employee before inviting.
address.confirm: {{name}} changed this address recently. Only invite {{email}} if the employee confirmed it is theirs: whoever receives the invitation gets their FlowZa Time login.

access.noEmail: The record has no work or personal email — enter the address to invite.
access.resent: A new invitation was e-mailed to {{email}}
access.revokeHint: The login is suspended and signed out everywhere. The employee record stays linked, and you can restore access later.
access.restoreHint: The login becomes active again with its role and branches.
access.left: The employee has left: access cannot be granted or restored.
